articles.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
articles.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
articles.summaryTr: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
articles.articleText: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say - Published European leaders have said they are ready for negotiations with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine, in a strong show of support for Kyiv. "Europe has a clear and consistent and united negotiating position," UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stressed that Moscow's "maximalist demands are not realistic". They were speaking at Berlin's summit of Ukraine's allies known as the Coalition of the Willing. US President Donald Trump's envoys were also there, and his son-in-law Jared Kushner said Trump wanted to make a deal with Russia "with Europe by his side". Russia's Vladimir Putin has so far rejected any European role in the US led peace talks. Trump had earlier held historic trilateral talks in Shenzhen with Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping and later dialled into the Berlin summit from Air Force One. In a lengthy press conference following his talks with Trump and Xi, Putin addressed the question of multilateral peace talks, saying the Americans were "insistently" asking Russia to allow the Europeans to take part. Putin claimed Russia was not against the idea but said Moscow wanted to clarify "what Europe will bring to these talks". "That is why, through diplomatic channels, we have invited the Europeans to come to Moscow in order to determine their positions. And after that, we will decide in what format we will continue the dialogue with Ukraine." But Putin also said that "every day" Russia heard that European leaders were talking about war coming in 2030. "But we are not planning to attack anyone... Is that normal? I do not think so," he said. Still, Putin added, Russia understood that "discussing issues linked to security in Europe is pointless without the Europeans". Jared Kushner told reporters that the US president had come away from Shenzhen believing that "peace is achievable". Striking an upbeat note, Kushner said that the Russians were willing to trust the instinct of the US envoys "on our behalf" that the Europeans should be at the table and that Moscow was now "comfortable" with Ukraine having security guarantees based on the idea enshrined in Nato's Article Five that requires allies to come to a country's defence if it comes under attack. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has long sought a guarantee equivalent to Nato's collective defence clause, and there has been little indication that Putin would accept that kind of condition. Russia has never accepted the idea of Ukrainian membership of Nato, but Article Five-style guarantees could theoretically be offered to Kyiv without being part of the Western defensive alliance. Zelensky and the three European leaders - Merz, Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron - were not as upbeat as Kushner, and the Ukrainian president made clear that the Russian president had spurned every proposal so far: "Putin has always said no." The German chancellor was equally sceptical, although he said with US involvement the chance of peace was increasing. Europe was willing to enter "serious discussions on European security" with Russia, he explained, "as long as it's matched with a serious discussion and only first a peace agreement with Ukraine". "These talks have to begin, and we will accept if conditions are acceptable for Europe and Ukraine," said Merz. There have been mixed messages from Moscow on European participation to the talks. Last week, following a visit to Moscow, Witkoff and Kushner appeared certain that Europe would soon have a seat at the negotiating table. But the Russians were more circumspect and this week Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said a "great deal" would have to be done before the format could be expanded, suggesting that several more rounds of discussions would have to be held before any four-sided talks could take place. Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. While Russia has engaged with several rounds of talks over the last year, little in Moscow's rhetoric or actions suggests that the Kremlin is considering scaling down its war on Ukraine. It continues to pound Kyiv's energy infrastructure to cripple it as winter takes hold, increasing numbers of civilian casualties are being recorded across the country, and Kremlin officials haven't budged from Russia's demands for Ukraine sovereign territory. As delegations were meeting in China and Germany on Thursday, several buildings in Kyiv's historic centre came under attack from drones. One person was killed in a strike on a residential building in the Podilskyi neighbourhood, while the Dutch and Austrian embassies as well as Saint Volodymyr's Cathedral reported damage. And today, Putin vowed that Moscow's response to a Ukrainian strike on the Crimean Bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea would be "considerably more painful" than what Kyiv had achieved. He also said he had discussed a "possible ceasefire in a number of areas" but had decided against it after the attack on the bridge. Still, Putin claimed to be "interested" in ending the war and was ready for making compromises, while Ukraine and Europe were not. "I assure you, we have no desire at all to continue this armed conflict," Putin said.

articles.summaryTr: Baykar tarafından geliştirilen KIZILELMA'nın ilk 3 adedi kabul testlerinin tamamlanmasının ardından güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. Türkiye, insansız savaş uçağını envanterine alan dünyadaki ilk ülke oldu.
articles.articleText: Türkiye’nin ilk insansız savaş uçağı KIZILELMA envantere girdi: İlk 3 uçak teslim edildi - Baykar tarafından geliştirilen KIZILELMA'nın ilk 3 adedi kabul testlerinin tamamlanmasının ardından güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. Türkiye, insansız savaş uçağını envanterine alan dünyadaki ilk ülke oldu. Türkiye'nin ilk insansız savaş uçağı Bayraktar KIZILELMA, kabul testlerini başarıyla tamamlayarak envantere girdi. Baykar tarafından yapılan açıklamaya göre, ilk 3 KIZILELMA güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Proje kapsamında bugüne kadar gerçekleştirilen test ve eğitim faaliyetlerinde toplam 600 sorti yapıldı. Teslimatla birlikte KIZILELMA aktif olarak göreve başladı. 2022'de üretim hattına girdi, ilk uçuşunu 2022'de yaptı Kavramsal tasarım görselleri 20 Temmuz 2021'de kamuoyuyla paylaşılan KIZILELMA, 12 Mart 2022'de üretim hattına girdi. İlk uçuşunu ise 14 Aralık 2022'de gerçekleştirdi. 24 Nisan 2023'te AKINCI TİHA ile dünyada ilk kez iki insansız hava aracının yakın kol uçuşunu gerçekleştiren KIZILELMA, aynı yıl TEKNOFEST İstanbul'da insanlı savaş uçakları SOLOTÜRK ve Türk Yıldızları ile kol uçuşu yaptı. Hava-hava muharebesinde tarihi başarı KIZILELMA, 29 Kasım 2025'te Sinop açıklarında gerçekleştirilen testte önemli bir başarıya imza attı. ASELSAN tarafından geliştirilen MURAD AESA radarının işaretlediği jet motorlu hedef uçak, TÜBİTAK SAGE üretimi GÖKDOĞAN görüş ötesi hava-hava füzesiyle vuruldu. Bu testle KIZILELMA, görüş ötesi hava-hava füzesi kullanarak jet motorlu bir hava hedefini vuran dünyadaki ilk insansız savaş uçağı oldu. Süpersonik füze ve dahili mühimmat yuvası testleri Milli insansız savaş uçağı, 13 Temmuz 2026'da JET-230 süpersonik füzesiyle gerçekleştirdiği atış testinde hedefini tam isabetle vurdu. Aynı ay içerisinde düşük görünürlük kabiliyetinin önemli unsurlarından biri olan dahili mühimmat yuvasından TEBER-82 ve TOLUN mühimmatlarıyla ilk atış testleri de başarıyla tamamlandı. Baykar'ın ihracatı 2,2 milyar dolara ulaştı KIZILELMA'nın geliştiricisi Baykar, 2025 yılında 2,2 milyar dolarlık ihracat hacmine ulaştı. Şirket, gelirlerinin yüzde 90'ını ihracattan elde etti. Baykar, Bayraktar TB2 için 37, AKINCI TİHA için 16 ülkeyle ihracat anlaşması imzaladı. Şirketin açıklamasına göre toplam ihracat anlaşması yapılan ülke sayısı 40'a ulaştı. Selçuk Bayraktar: 3 adet KIZILELMA'yı teslim etmenin gururunu yaşıyoruz Baykar Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Selçuk Bayraktar, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada KIZILELMA'nın göreve başladığını duyurdu. Bayraktar, ilk 3 uçağın teslimatına ilişkin şu ifadeleri kullandı: "Dünyada ilk kez bir insansız savaş uçağı envantere giriyor. Vatanımızın her karış toprağını ve göklerimizi korumak üzere 3 adet KIZILELMA'mızı güvenlik güçlerimize teslim etmenin gururunu yaşıyoruz." ASELSAN ve Savunma Sanayii Başkanlığı'ndan açıklama ASELSAN Genel Müdürü Ahmet Akyol, KIZILELMA'nın envantere girmesinin Türkiye havacılık tarihinde yeni bir sayfa açtığını belirterek, projeye ileri teknolojilerle katkı sunmaktan gurur duyduklarını ifade etti. Savunma Sanayii Başkanı Haluk Görgün ise KIZILELMA'nın 20 yıllık bir hayalin gerçeğe dönüşmesi olduğunu vurguladı. Görgün, projede görev alan mühendis ve teknisyenleri tebrik ederek insansız savaş uçağının Türkiye'ye ve Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri'ne hayırlı olmasını diledi.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.summary: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.summaryTr: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
articles.articleText: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies. Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could be pushed back as far as May 2027 if developers decide to modify its specifications to address smart contract compatibility issues, according to discussions at Thursday’s All Core Developers meeting. Glamsterdam is a planned Ethereum hard fork aimed at increasing the network’s capacity and efficiency. However, blockchain security firm ChainSecurity warned in October that proposed changes to Ethereum’s gas pricing could disrupt existing smart contracts and potentially expose them to exploitation, prompting developers to postpone the Hoodi testnet fork, originally scheduled for Oct. 26. The concerns center on gas repricing proposals EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. Researchers identified 13 real-world examples of potentially affected contracts in October, while a November investigation examined eight smart contract invariants that could be disrupted by the upgrade. During Thursday’s meeting, developers said the Ethereum Foundation, ChainSecurity and security firm Dedaub had collectively contacted at least 50 affected companies. Three projects were classified as high impact, with fixes completed or expected by mid-December, while medium-impact projects reported timelines extending to Jan. 10. Developers debated whether to retain Glamsterdam’s existing specifications or modify them to reduce compatibility risks, as changes intended to protect some contracts could disrupt others. “Every spec change could, again, break new invariants that we are not aware of breaking yet,” one developer warned during the meeting. Under the current specifications, mainnet activation could come as early as mid-January 2027. However, waiting until January to decide could push activation to late February or early March, or April or May if modifications are adopted, and no decision has been reached yet. Related: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest Ethereum weighs accelerating post-quantum security Separately, Ethereum’s next planned hard fork, Hegotá, could see its scope reduced as the network seeks to accelerate its transition to post-quantum cryptography. During the meeting, developers considered postponing some Ethereum Improvement Proposals to prioritize post-quantum features, although several argued that reducing the upgrade’s scope would offer little benefit unless it also shortened the rollout timeline. Developers also raised compatibility concerns over EIP-8151, a proposal designed to protect accounts migrating to post-quantum security. A preliminary review identified a potentially large number of existing smart contracts that could be affected by the changes, complicating the proposal’s inclusion in Hegotá. No decision was reached on Hegotá’s scope, with client teams expected to submit their positions ahead of further discussions in two weeks. Magazine: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship

articles.title: Küresel piyasalarda sert düzeltme riski: Aysun Karaytuğ tarih verdi
articles.summary: Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, küresel piyasalarda yüksek değerlemeler ve Fed'in faiz politikası nedeniyle sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Karaytuğ, büyük düzeltme beklentisi için 2027'nin Mart-Nisan dönemine işaret etti.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Küresel piyasalarda sert düzeltme riski: Aysun Karaytuğ tarih verdi
articles.summaryTr: Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, küresel piyasalarda yüksek değerlemeler ve Fed'in faiz politikası nedeniyle sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Karaytuğ, büyük düzeltme beklentisi için 2027'nin Mart-Nisan dönemine işaret etti.
articles.articleText: Küresel piyasalarda sert düzeltme riski: Aysun Karaytuğ tarih verdi - Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, küresel piyasalarda yüksek değerlemeler ve Fed'in faiz politikası nedeniyle sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Karaytuğ, büyük düzeltme beklentisi için 2027'nin Mart-Nisan dönemine işaret etti. Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, CNBC-e'de Burcu Göksüzoğlu'nun sunduğu 4'te Ekonomi programında küresel piyasalardaki gelişmeleri değerlendirdi. Yapay zeka şirketlerinin yüksek değerlemeleri, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) faiz politikası ve yatırımcıların değişen tercihleri hakkında konuşan Karaytuğ, önümüzdeki yıl piyasalarda sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) Başkanı Christine Lagarde'ın teknoloji şirketlerindeki yüksek değerlemelere yönelik uyarılarının hatırlatılması üzerine Göksüzoğlu, Karaytuğ'a "Lagarde'ın da bahsettiği gibi sen de böyle bir düzeltme, büyük bir düzeltme bekliyor musun?" sorusunu yöneltti. Karaytuğ, bu soruya "Martta, Mart-Nisan gibi bekliyoruz" yanıtını verdi. Karaytuğ, 2027'nin ilk aylarında ABD'deki siyasi gelişmelerin ve ticaret politikalarının piyasalar açısından belirleyici olacağını söyledi. Ocak ayında ABD'deki siyasi tablonun netleşeceğini, Çin'e yönelik tarifelerin de yeniden gündeme geleceğini belirten Karaytuğ, ticaret politikalarının enflasyon üzerindeki etkilerinin yakından izleneceğini ifade etti. Enerji fiyatlarının yanı sıra iklim koşullarından kaynaklanabilecek gıda fiyatı artışlarının da enflasyonist baskıları güçlendirebileceğini dile getiren Karaytuğ, bu gelişmelerin Fed'in faiz politikasını etkileyebileceğini söyledi. "Değerlemeler zaten çok yüksek" Teknoloji şirketlerindeki değerlemelerin ulaştığı seviyelere dikkat çeken Karaytuğ, faizlerin yeniden cazip hale gelmesinin riskli varlıklardan çıkışı hızlandırabileceğini belirtti. Fed'in faiz artırımlarına devam etmesini beklediklerini ancak 50 baz puanlık tek bir artış yerine 25'er baz puanlık adımların daha olası olduğunu düşündüklerini ifade etti. Karaytuğ, ekim ve kasım aylarında bazı varlıklarda zirve seviyelerinden yüzde 20'ye yaklaşan geri çekilmeler yaşandığını hatırlatarak yüksek değerlemeler ile sıkı para politikasının birleşmesinin piyasalardaki baskıyı artırabileceğini söyledi. Yatırımcıların parası nereye gidiyor? Piyasalardaki satışların ardından sermayenin hangi varlıklara yöneldiğine de değinen Karaytuğ, doların ve faiz getirisi sunan yatırım araçlarının öne çıktığını belirtti. Doların güçlenmesinin özellikle dolar cinsinden fiyatlanan emtialar üzerinde baskı oluşturduğunu ifade eden Karaytuğ, yabancı para birimleriyle yatırım yapanlar açısından bu varlıkların daha pahalı hale geldiğini anlattı. Karaytuğ, yatırımcıların mevcut eğilimi takip etmeyi sürdürebileceğini ve bu sürecin Mart 2027'ye kadar devam edebileceğini öngördü. Altındaki düşüşte yapay zeka etkisine dikkat çekti Altın fiyatlarındaki gerilemeyi de değerlendiren Karaytuğ, satış baskısının yalnızca Fed'in faiz politikası ve güçlü dolardan kaynaklanmadığını söyledi. Anthropic'in halka arzı gibi büyük teknoloji yatırımlarının da yatırımcıların tercihlerini değiştirdiğini belirten Karaytuğ, değerli metallerden yapay zeka ve teknoloji şirketlerine doğru sermaye geçişi yaşandığını ifade etti. Karaytuğ, kısa vadede altın üzerindeki baskının devam edebileceğini ancak bu eğilimin kalıcı olmasını beklemediklerini dile getirdi. Fed'de 50 baz puanlık artış ihtimalini değerlendirdi Fed'in aralık ayındaki faiz kararına ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Karaytuğ, piyasalarda 25 baz puanlık artış olasılığının yüzde 95, 50 baz puanlık artış olasılığının ise yüzde 5 olarak fiyatlandığını söyledi. 50 baz puanlık artışın mevcut koşullarda oldukça agresif bir adım olacağını belirten Karaytuğ, Fed'in tek bir enflasyon veya istihdam verisine dayanarak böyle bir karar vermesini beklemediklerini ifade etti. Karaytuğ'a göre beklenenden güçlü bir faiz artışı yalnızca ABD piyasalarını değil, Avrupa, Japonya ve İngiltere başta olmak üzere küresel ekonomiyi de etkileyebilir. Karaytuğ, tüm bu riskler birlikte değerlendirildiğinde küresel piyasalarda büyük bir düzeltme açısından 2027'nin Mart-Nisan döneminin öne çıktığını vurguladı.

Karaytuğ, büyük düzeltme beklentisi için 2027'nin Mart-Nisan dönemine işaret etti. Yapay zeka şirketlerinin yüksek değerlemeleri, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) faiz politikası ve yatırımcıların değişen tercihleri hakkında konuşan Karaytuğ, önümüzdeki yıl piyasalarda sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) Başkanı Christine Lagarde'ın teknoloji şirketlerindeki yüksek değerlemelere yönelik uyarılarının hatırlatılması üzerine Göksüzoğlu, Karaytuğ'a "Lagarde'ın da bahsettiği gibi sen de böyle bir düzeltme, büyük bir düzeltme bekliyor musun?" sorusunu yöneltti. Karaytuğ, bu soruya "Martta, Mart-Nisan gibi bekliyoruz" yanıtını verdi. Karaytuğ, 2027'nin ilk aylarında ABD'deki siyasi gelişmelerin ve ticaret politikalarının piyasalar açısından belirleyici olacağını söyledi. Ocak ayında ABD'deki siyasi tablonun netleşeceğini, Çin'e yönelik tarifelerin de yeniden gündeme geleceğini belirten Karaytuğ, ticaret politikalarının enflasyon üzerindeki etkilerinin yakından izleneceğini ifade etti. Enerji fiyatlarının yanı sıra iklim koşullarından kaynaklanabilecek gıda fiyatı artışlarının da enflasyonist baskıları güçlendirebileceğini dile getiren Karaytuğ, bu gelişmelerin Fed'in faiz politikasını etkileyebileceğini söyledi. "Değerlemeler zaten çok yüksek" Teknoloji şirketlerindeki değerlemelerin ulaştığı seviyelere dikkat çeken Karaytuğ, faizlerin yeniden cazip hale gelmesinin riskli varlıklardan çıkışı hızlandırabileceğini belirtti. Fed'in faiz artırımlarına devam etmesini beklediklerini ancak 50 baz puanlık tek bir artış yerine 25'er baz puanlık adımların daha olası olduğunu düşündüklerini ifade etti. Karaytuğ, ekim ve kasım aylarında bazı varlıklarda zirve seviyelerinden yüzde 20'ye yaklaşan geri çekilmeler yaşandığını hatırlatarak yüksek değerlemeler ile sıkı para politikasının birleşmesinin piyasalardaki baskıyı artırabileceğini söyledi. Yatırımcıların parası nereye gidiyor? Piyasalardaki satışların ardından sermayenin hangi varlıklara yöneldiğine de değinen Karaytuğ, doların ve faiz getirisi sunan yatırım araçlarının öne çıktığını belirtti. Doların güçlenmesinin özellikle dolar cinsinden fiyatlanan emtialar üzerinde baskı oluşturduğunu ifade eden Karaytuğ, yabancı para birimleriyle yatırım yapanlar açısından bu varlıkların daha pahalı hale geldiğini anlattı. Karaytuğ, yatırımcıların mevcut eğilimi takip etmeyi sürdürebileceğini ve bu sürecin Mart 2027'ye kadar devam edebileceğini öngördü. Altındaki düşüşte yapay zeka etkisine dikkat çekti Altın fiyatlarındaki gerilemeyi de değerlendiren Karaytuğ, satış baskısının yalnızca Fed'in faiz politikası ve güçlü dolardan kaynaklanmadığını söyledi. Anthropic'in halka arzı gibi büyük teknoloji yatırımlarının da yatırımcıların tercihlerini değiştirdiğini belirten Karaytuğ, değerli metallerden yapay zeka ve teknoloji şirketlerine doğru sermaye geçişi yaşandığını ifade etti. Karaytuğ, kısa vadede altın üzerindeki baskının devam edebileceğini ancak bu eğilimin kalıcı olmasını beklemediklerini dile getirdi. Fed'de 50 baz puanlık artış ihtimalini değerlendirdi Fed'in aralık ayındaki faiz kararına ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Karaytuğ, piyasalarda 25 baz puanlık artış olasılığının yüzde 95, 50 baz puanlık artış olasılığının ise yüzde 5 olarak fiyatlandığını söyledi. 50 baz puanlık artışın mevcut koşullarda oldukça agresif bir adım olacağını belirten Karaytuğ, Fed'in tek bir enflasyon veya istihdam verisine dayanarak böyle bir karar vermesini beklemediklerini ifade etti. Karaytuğ'a göre beklenenden güçlü bir faiz artışı yalnızca ABD piyasalarını değil, Avrupa, Japonya ve İngiltere başta olmak üzere küresel ekonomiyi de etkileyebilir. Karaytuğ, tüm bu riskler birlikte değerlendirildiğinde küresel piyasalarda büyük bir düzeltme açısından 2027'nin Mart-Nisan döneminin öne çıktığını vurguladı.

articles.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
articles.summary: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
articles.summaryTr: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.
articles.articleText: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting - Published US President Donald Trump and his Russian and Chinese counterparts Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping have issued a "joint declaration of peace" following historic trilateral talks. The three leaders met for 90 minutes in China's south-eastern city of Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. While the presidents have previously had one-on-one meetings, these are their first trilateral talks. In the declaration, they said "nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought" and that the countries planned to increase the production and supply of petroleum. They also said they were "committed to reform the UN" to respond more effectively to global challenges. Thursday's statement also flagged the issue of immunity enjoyed by state officials and said "they agreed that the International Criminal Court and other similar institutions must not abuse their jurisdiction". Trump praised the trilateral meeting calling it "a great and highly consequential trip", in a social media post while flying back to Washington on Air Force One. In the same post, the president announced he would host a news conference to talk about the trip on Friday at the White House. While in China, Trump met Putin ahead of the trilateral, in their first meeting since August 2025, where the US president greeted his Russian counterpart as his "friend". He also spoke with Xi in a separate conversation, describing the pair's relationship as "very special". Beyond the warmth and shared niceties, however, the three men had different goals and motivations for the sit-down. - Analysis: Trilateral summit high on spectacle, short on substance - Published1 hour ago - This is a remarkable diplomatic moment for China's Xi - but it comes with pitfalls - Published14 hours ago The opening remarks of the trilateral gave some indication about what was to be discussed during the closed-door meeting. Before giving the floor to his fellow leaders, Xi said that "positive interaction among major powers is not a matter of choice, but a mandatory requirement". Putin followed this by highlighting a shared interest in ending the Ukraine war and said the conversation would also touch on food and energy security. China has officially remained neutral since Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, rejecting accusations from Kyiv and its allies that it has been tacitly supporting Moscow, including by exporting dual-use technology used by the Russian military. Beijing has also repeatedly called for negotiations and a political settlement while avoiding condemnation of Russia's aggression. Meanwhile, Trump closed by saying the presidents of three of the world's largest countries have a "special responsibility" to maintain productive dialogue. "Too often past leaders have avoided talking to nations with whom they had disagreements," he said, adding: "We feel the opposite." Trump referenced the three countries' nuclear capabilities and said they are "uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth". It is "vital" that they co-operate to "combat the threat of nuclear proliferation in other countries around the world", he said, adding: "That's what we're doing in Iran." "We're not going to let Iran have a nuclear weapon". Trump then turned to Ukraine and said he and Putin have had a "long discussion" on the conflict there already. He added that Putin "and I hope the other side, would like to see an end to that war". Putin addressed the media following the trilateral meeting and described it as an "important chapter in the history of diplomacy". He said Ukraine and Europe were not yet ready to make compromises to resolve the conflict in Ukraine - but he said Russia had invited EU representatives to Moscow to better understand Europe's position. As the talks were under way in China, and even as Putin was holding his press conference claiming to be ready for peace, Ukraine's capital Kyiv was under attack from Russian drones. Putin has repeatedly rejected all ceasefire offers from Ukraine, insisting on his maximalist demands which Kyiv and its European allies say are tantamount to de facto capitulation of Ukraine. In Shenzhen, the Kremlin leader also vowed a "far more painful" retaliation in response to Ukrainian attacks on the bridge connecting Russia to Ukraine's occupied peninsula of Crimea. A missile and drone attack on Tuesday destroyed its central road section. There was no mention from Putin of almost five years of Russian attacks on power plants, bridges and residential buildings in Ukraine. The Russian president also directly addressed comparisons between his meeting with Trump and Xi and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the leaders of the Soviet Union, Britain and the US met towards the end of World War Two. "Nobody divided up the world at Yalta. It simply codified the realities that had emerged after WW2. "And when it comes to today's conflicts, the realities on the ground will have to be accepted." The Kremlin released a video showing Putin leaving the summit venue and saying goodbye to Xi. "Thank you for organising this," Putin said. "I don't think anyone even expected everything to go so well." Meanwhile, China's president described his meeting with Putin and Trump as "positive, constructive, and highly productive", according to the country's state broadcaster CCTV. It added that Xi recalled "the history of fighting side-by-side during WW2", as the three leaders emphasised the importance of "cherishing the hard-won peace". Thursday's trilateral meeting was reportedly the idea of Putin. Some Russian newspapers called it a "diplomatic victory" as after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine many Western leaders were trying to isolate him. The summit also marked the first time since Russia's war in Ukraine began that Putin took part in an international gathering attended by leaders from countries including Canada, Japan and Australia. US lawmakers responded with frustration to Trump's warmth towards America's geopolitical adversaries. "I was encouraged by some of the commitments that came out of the President's meetings in Asia, particularly the recognition that nuclear war must never be fought," Republican Senator John Curtis said in an emailed statement to the BBC. But Curtis also said he was concerned about Trump's approach to the foreign leaders, adding that "Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are not our friends". "We should not treat them as though they share our values or interests," Curtis, who sits on the Senate foreign relations committee, added. "Doing so risks undermining our national security, weakening trust with our allies, and sending the wrong message about where America stands." Jeanne Shaheen, a ranking Democratic member on the same committee, chose harsher words in her comment. "President Trump's 'friend' is a murderous war criminal," she wrote on X. With additional reporting from Brandon Drenon

A missile and drone attack on Tuesday destroyed its central road section. There was no mention from Putin of almost five years of Russian attacks on power plants, bridges and residential buildings in Ukraine. The Russian president also directly addressed comparisons between his meeting with Trump and Xi and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the leaders of the Soviet Union, Britain and the US met towards the end of World War Two. "Nobody divided up the world at Yalta. It simply codified the realities that had emerged after WW2. "And when it comes to today's conflicts, the realities on the ground will have to be accepted." The Kremlin released a video showing Putin leaving the summit venue and saying goodbye to Xi. "Thank you for organising this," Putin said. "I don't think anyone even expected everything to go so well." Meanwhile, China's president described his meeting with Putin and Trump as "positive, constructive, and highly productive", according to the country's state broadcaster CCTV. It added that Xi recalled "the history of fighting side-by-side during WW2", as the three leaders emphasised the importance of "cherishing the hard-won peace". Thursday's trilateral meeting was reportedly the idea of Putin. Some Russian newspapers called it a "diplomatic victory" as after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine many Western leaders were trying to isolate him. The summit also marked the first time since Russia's war in Ukraine began that Putin took part in an international gathering attended by leaders from countries including Canada, Japan and Australia. US lawmakers responded with frustration to Trump's warmth towards America's geopolitical adversaries. "I was encouraged by some of the commitments that came out of the President's meetings in Asia, particularly the recognition that nuclear war must never be fought," Republican Senator John Curtis said in an emailed statement to the BBC. But Curtis also said he was concerned about Trump's approach to the foreign leaders, adding that "Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are not our friends". "We should not treat them as though they share our values or interests," Curtis, who sits on the Senate foreign relations committee, added. "Doing so risks undermining our national security, weakening trust with our allies, and sending the wrong message about where America stands." Jeanne Shaheen, a ranking Democratic member on the same committee, chose harsher words in her comment. "President Trump's 'friend' is a murderous war criminal," she wrote on X. articles.articleText: Rohingya genocide: What was said in court and what happens now? Myanmar has been found guilty of committing genocide against its Rohingya minority by the International Court of Justice (ICJ). The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court. The court found on Thursday that "genocidal intent is the only reasonable inference that can be drawn from the evidence" it had seen. Günün en çok kazandıran 30 hissesi 19 Kasım'da en çok yükselen hisseler listesindeki 30 şirketin tamamı: Borsada günün tablosu 19 Kasım Perşembe günü BIST 100 endeksi yüzde 0,67 düşerken en çok yükselen hisselerde yüzde 10'a, en çok düşen hisselerde ise yüzde 10'a ulaşan fiyat değişimleri görüldü. Böylece endeksin negatif seyrettiği günde hisse bazında ayrışma öne çıktı.

articles.title: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons
articles.summary: At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons
articles.summaryTr: At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".
articles.articleText: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons - Published A South Carolina woman who admitted to drowning her two sons 32 years ago has been denied parole for a second time. Susan Smith, 55, was convicted of killing her boys by strapping them into their car seats and rolling her vehicle into a lake in 1994. "I got to my lowest when I let that car go into that lake," Smith said during a hearing on Thursday with the state board that decides whether to release those in prison on parole. The seven-member board later unanimously turned down her request to be freed. The father of the two boys has vowed to continue to oppose her release, and several people spoke against her in the hearing. Smith, whose lawyers had argued she suffered a mental breakdown during the crime, can apply to the South Carolina Board of Probation, Parole and Pardon Services for parole every two years. She told the board that she had changed and matured since killing three-year-old Michael and one-year-old Alex, and that "I am not the same person I was 32 years ago". She also said she was "very, very sorry" and that she would go back and change the circumstances if she could. "They were innocent children," Smith said. "They did not deserve to die." Her children's father, David Smith, attended the hearing so he could advocate for their sons, he said. The 32 years, he said, do not take away what Smith "deliberately" did. "I know in my heart granting her parole would be a huge injustice to Michael and Alex," said David Smith, who had pinned a photo of both his sons to his lapel. Prosecutors argued during the trial that Smith killed the boys after a man with whom she was having an affair told her that her sons were the reason that the pair did not have a future together. At Thursday's hearing, Smith said: "This did not happen because of a man. That's just not true." When the boys first disappeared, Smith said she was carjacked late at night and a man drove away with her car. While she pleaded publicly for their safe return, her sons were at the bottom of a nearby lake. But ultimately she confessed to the crime. Defence lawyers said she had wanted to die with her children but left the car at the last minute. Smith was convicted of murder. Under South Carolina law at the time, she was allowed to request parole every two years after serving 30 years in prison. In the US, some people convicted of crimes are eligible for parole, which means they can be released from incarceration. She would have needed two-thirds of the board members present to vote in her favour to be freed. Related topics - Published20 November 2024

articles.title: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
articles.summary: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
articles.summaryTr: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.
articles.articleText: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line - Published Israeli forces have completed a rare ground operation in part of central Gaza outside their control, the military says, a day after residents were ordered to evacuate. Families fled their homes and tents on Wednesday as tanks advanced into an area east of Nuseirat refugee camp and onto the territory's main north-south road under the cover of artillery strikes. The Israeli military said the "targeted" operation aimed to dismantle a "terror tunnel" west of the so-called Yellow Line, which marks the more than 60% of Gaza's territory occupied by Israel. The Palestinian armed group Hamas, which controls the rest of Gaza, accused Israel of a "flagrant violation" of the October 2025 ceasefire deal. Violence has continued in Gaza over the past 13 months, with near-daily Israeli strikes, and living conditions for the 2.1 million people there remain dire. Wednesday's Israeli incursion deep beyond the Yellow Line was reportedly the first to be publicly announced by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) since the ceasefire began. In the early afternoon, Israeli military body Cogat's Arabic spokesperson announced the start of the operation and warned Palestinians living in an area north of Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camp to stay away for their own safety. It also said a section of Salah al-Din road that passed through the area would be closed to traffic. In the evening, the IDF said the joint operation with the Shin Bet security service sought "to dismantle a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line that posed an immediate and direct threat to IDF troops". On Thursday morning, Cogat told Palestinians on social media that "the activity has ended, and the Salah al-Din axis has been reopened". Hamas warned in a statement that the advance of Israeli military vehicles beyond the Yellow Line and the evacuation of residents constituted "a dangerous development and a flagrant violation of the ceasefire agreement". Gaza's Hamas-run government media office meanwhile said that an estimated 6,000 people had fled their homes and tents because of the operation, and that this amounted to the war crime of forced displacement. Footage published by Palestinian media outlets and on social media showed dozens of families fleeing areas near Nuseirat camp following the Israeli evacuation order. In one video verified by BBC Verify, a man could be seen ducking after hearing artillery fire and then running along Salah al-Din road, about 1.5km (0.9 miles) west of the Yellow Line. "The Israeli occupation now is firing randomly near the houses and tents of people," he said. An image, meanwhile, showed six armoured vehicles, including tanks and bulldozers, around Salah al-Din road. A resident of Nuseirat who was forced to flee told BBC Arabic's Middle East Daily programme: "The situation is now extremely dire, with Israeli forces firing indiscriminately at areas where displaced people have sought shelter." "We couldn't take any of our belongings with us - not even our blankets, pillows, or clothes. We had no choice but to leave everything behind." A second resident also reported "indiscriminate gunfire and shelling" and said there had been "numerous casualties, including fatalities". Asked about those reports, the IDF sent a general statement about the operation. Multiple verified videos of the aftermath of the incursion on Thursday showed destruction, earth banks, and heavy vehicle tracks more than 1.2km beyond the Yellow Line. That is believed to be the furthest Israeli troops have advanced into central Gaza since they occupied the so-called Netzarim Corridor before the ceasefire. Some residents returned to check their properties following the Israeli withdrawal. "The entire area has been destroyed, and we honestly do not know what to do," Abd Aliwa told Reuters news agency as he sat beside a pile of rubble. - Israel moves Yellow Line deeper into Gaza, satellite images show - Published16 January Gaza's Hamas-run Civil Defence agency said three people were killed and others were wounded in three separate Israeli drone strikes on Wednesday. One man was killed in Nuseirat, the second was killed to the north in Gaza City, and the third was killed in the central town of Deir al-Balah, it added. The IDF told the BBC that it had "struck several military operatives". Gaza health officials said another two people were killed on Thursday by Israeli fire in eastern Gaza City, according to Reuters. There was no immediate comment from the IDF. At least 1,662 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza since the ceasefire began last year, according to the territory's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. The Israeli military says six of its soldiers have been killed over the same period. Meanwhile, more than 1.9 million people - about 90% of Gaza's population - remain displaced, with 1.4 million of them living in tents or makeshift shelters, according to the UN. Reconstruction has yet to begin in Gaza, where an estimated 82% of all structures have been destroyed or damaged during the war, as US President Donald Trump's peace plan has largely stalled. The disarmament of Hamas has been a key sticking point. The group has agreed to give up its weapons in exchange for a phased withdrawal of Israeli troops from the 60% of Gaza they currently occupy. But Israel has insisted that Hamas must fully disarm before any pullout. The war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,710 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza, its health ministry says. Related topics - Published3 days ago - Published4 days ago - Published7 days ago

Violence has continued in Gaza over the past 13 months, with near-daily Israeli strikes, and living conditions for the 2.1 million people there remain dire. Wednesday's Israeli incursion deep beyond the Yellow Line was reportedly the first to be publicly announced by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) since the ceasefire began. In the early afternoon, Israeli military body Cogat's Arabic spokesperson announced the start of the operation and warned Palestinians living in an area north of Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camp to stay away for their own safety. It also said a section of Salah al-Din road that passed through the area would be closed to traffic. In the evening, the IDF said the joint operation with the Shin Bet security service sought "to dismantle a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line that posed an immediate and direct threat to IDF troops". On Thursday morning, Cogat told Palestinians on social media that "the activity has ended, and the Salah al-Din axis has been reopened". Hamas warned in a statement that the advance of Israeli military vehicles beyond the Yellow Line and the evacuation of residents constituted "a dangerous development and a flagrant violation of the ceasefire agreement". Gaza's Hamas-run government media office meanwhile said that an estimated 6,000 people had fled their homes and tents because of the operation, and that this amounted to the war crime of forced displacement. Footage published by Palestinian media outlets and on social media showed dozens of families fleeing areas near Nuseirat camp following the Israeli evacuation order. In one video verified by BBC Verify, a man could be seen ducking after hearing artillery fire and then running along Salah al-Din road, about 1.5km (0.9 miles) west of the Yellow Line. "The Israeli occupation now is firing randomly near the houses and tents of people," he said. An image, meanwhile, showed six armoured vehicles, including tanks and bulldozers, around Salah al-Din road. A resident of Nuseirat who was forced to flee told BBC Arabic's Middle East Daily programme: "The situation is now extremely dire, with Israeli forces firing indiscriminately at areas where displaced people have sought shelter." "We couldn't take any of our belongings with us - not even our blankets, pillows, or clothes. We had no choice but to leave everything behind." A second resident also reported "indiscriminate gunfire and shelling" and said there had been "numerous casualties, including fatalities". Asked about those reports, the IDF sent a general statement about the operation. Multiple verified videos of the aftermath of the incursion on Thursday showed destruction, earth banks, and heavy vehicle tracks more than 1.2km beyond the Yellow Line. That is believed to be the furthest Israeli troops have advanced into central Gaza since they occupied the so-called Netzarim Corridor before the ceasefire. Some residents returned to check their properties following the Israeli withdrawal. "The entire area has been destroyed, and we honestly do not know what to do," Abd Aliwa told Reuters news agency as he sat beside a pile of rubble. - Israel moves Yellow Line deeper into Gaza, satellite images show - Published16 January Gaza's Hamas-run Civil Defence agency said three people were killed and others were wounded in three separate Israeli drone strikes on Wednesday. One man was killed in Nuseirat, the second was killed to the north in Gaza City, and the third was killed in the central town of Deir al-Balah, it added. The IDF told the BBC that it had "struck several military operatives". Gaza health officials said another two people were killed on Thursday by Israeli fire in eastern Gaza City, according to Reuters. There was no immediate comment from the IDF. At least 1,662 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza since the ceasefire began last year, according to the territory's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. The Israeli military says six of its soldiers have been killed over the same period. Meanwhile, more than 1.9 million people - about 90% of Gaza's population - remain displaced, with 1.4 million of them living in tents or makeshift shelters, according to the UN. Reconstruction has yet to begin in Gaza, where an estimated 82% of all structures have been destroyed or damaged during the war, as US President Donald Trump's peace plan has largely stalled. The disarmament of Hamas has been a key sticking point. The group has agreed to give up its weapons in exchange for a phased withdrawal of Israeli troops from the 60% of Gaza they currently occupy. But Israel has insisted that Hamas must fully disarm before any pullout. The war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. articles.summaryTr: Claude'un geliştiricisi Anthropic, 83 dolardan fiyatlanan halka arzının ardından Nasdaq'taki ilk işlem gününe 111,50 dolardan başladı. Şirket, halka arzla 81,3 milyar dolar kaynak sağlayarak tarihin en büyük halka arzına imza attı.
articles.articleText: Halka arz fiyatının yüzde 34 üstüne çıktı! Anthropic değerlemesi 2 trilyon dolar oldu - Claude'un geliştiricisi Anthropic, 83 dolardan fiyatlanan halka arzının ardından Nasdaq'taki ilk işlem gününe 111,50 dolardan başladı. Şirket, halka arzla 81,3 milyar dolar kaynak sağlayarak tarihin en büyük halka arzına imza attı. Yapay zeka şirketi Anthropic, Nasdaq'taki işlem hayatına başladı. Claude sohbet robotunun geliştiricisi şirketin hisseleri, halka arz fiyatı olan 83 doların üzerinde, 111,50 dolardan açıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ANT koduyla işlem gören şirket, halka arz kapsamında 980 milyon hisseyi 83 dolardan satarak toplam 81,3 milyar dolar kaynak sağladı. Böylece Anthropic, tarihin en büyük halka arzını gerçekleştirdi. Gelirini bir yılda yüzde 1.200 artırdı 2021 yılında kurulan Anthropic, Claude yapay zeka modelleri ve ürünleriyle teknoloji sektöründe hızlı büyüme kaydetti. Şirketin halka arz izahnamesine göre 30 Eylül'de sona eren dokuz aylık dönemde 33,24 milyar dolar gelir elde edildi. Bu rakam, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 1.200 artışa işaret etti. OpenAI'dan ayrılan araştırmacılar kurdu Anthropic, CEO Dario Amodei ve aralarında bir grup araştırmacının da bulunduğu ekip tarafından 2021 yılında kuruldu. Ekip, şirketi kurmadan önce OpenAI'dan ayrılmıştı. Yapay zeka güvenliği, düzenlemeler ve ulusal güvenlik konularındaki yaklaşımı nedeniyle eleştirilerle de karşılaşan şirketin halka arzı, yapay zeka sektörüne yönelik yatırımcı iştahının önemli göstergelerinden biri olarak değerlendiriliyor.

articles.title: Kiler Holding'den KAP'a açıklama: "Tüm işlemler mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildi"
articles.summary: Kiler Holding, Ümit Özlale'nin şirket ve ortakları hakkındaki iddialarını reddederek suç duyurusunda bulunduğunu ve tazminat davaları açtığını duyurdu. Şirket, tüm işlemlerin mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildiğini ve gerekli KAP bildirimlerinin yapıldığını savundu.

articles.titleTr: Kiler Holding'den KAP'a açıklama: "Tüm işlemler mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildi"
articles.summaryTr: Kiler Holding, Ümit Özlale'nin şirket ve ortakları hakkındaki iddialarını reddederek suç duyurusunda bulunduğunu ve tazminat davaları açtığını duyurdu. Şirket, tüm işlemlerin mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildiğini ve gerekli KAP bildirimlerinin yapıldığını savundu.
articles.articleText: Kiler Holding'den KAP'a açıklama: "Tüm işlemler mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildi" - Kiler Holding, Ümit Özlale'nin şirket ve ortakları hakkındaki iddialarını reddederek suç duyurusunda bulunduğunu ve tazminat davaları açtığını duyurdu. Şirket, tüm işlemlerin mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildiğini ve gerekli KAP bildirimlerinin yapıldığını savundu. Kiler Holding (KLRHO), YENİ Parti İzmir Milletvekili Ümit Özlale'nin şirket ve ortakları hakkındaki açıklamalarına ilişkin kamuoyu duyurusu yayımladı. Şirket, 19 Kasım 2026 tarihli açıklamasında iddiaları reddederek Özlale hakkında suç duyurusunda bulunduğunu ve tazminat davaları açtığını bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Holding, 10 binden fazla kişiye istihdam sağlayan şirketler grubunun siyasi çıkarlar uğruna hedef alındığını savunarak, açıklamaları "mesnetsiz, gerçek dışı ve iftira niteliğinde" olarak nitelendirdi. "Tüm işlemler mevzuata uygun gerçekleştirildi" Kiler Holding, iddialara konu olan bütün işlemlerin ilgili mevzuata uygun şekilde gerçekleştirildiğini ve gerekli özel durum açıklamalarının Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımlandığını belirtti. Şirket, gizlenmiş veya kamuoyundan kaçırılmış herhangi bir işlem bulunmadığını savunarak, tüm kayıt ve belgelerin bağımsız denetime, yetkili kurumların incelemesine ve hukuki araştırmaya açık olduğunu ifade etti. Açıklamada, yapılacak incelemelerin iddiaların asılsız olduğunu ortaya koyacağına inanıldığı da kaydedildi. Ümit Özlale hakkında suç duyurusu Kiler Holding, Ümit Özlale hakkında suç duyurusunda bulunduğunu ve tazminat davaları açtığını duyurdu. Şirket ayrıca, açıklamalar nedeniyle zarar gören yatırımcıların haklarının korunması ve oluşan zararların tazmini için hukuki yollara başvuracağını bildirdi. Holding, milletvekili dokunulmazlığının mesnetsiz suçlamalarda bulunma hakkı vermediğini savunarak, iddialara ilişkin hukuki sürecin sonuna kadar takipçisi olacağını belirtti. Özlale, Kiler Holding ve Bulls bağlantılı işlemleri gündeme taşımıştı YENİ Parti İzmir Milletvekili Ümit Özlale, 19 Kasım'da TBMM'de düzenlediği basın toplantısında fon soruşturması kapsamında Kiler Holding ve Bulls bağlantılı hisse işlemlerini gündeme getirmişti. Özlale, Kiler ailesinin 2025 yılında 6,53 milyar liraya sattığı hisseleri, fiyatların gerilemesinin ardından yaklaşık 3,48 milyar liraya geri aldığını öne sürmüştü. Bu işlemler sonucunda ortakların yaklaşık 69 milyon adet ilave hisseye sahip olduğunu ve satış ile alış bedelleri arasında 3 milyar 53 milyon liralık fark oluştuğunu iddia etmişti. Özlale, söz konusu işlemlerin SPK ve ilgili kurumlar tarafından incelenmesini istemişti. Kiler Holding ise açıklamasında tüm işlemlerin mevzuata uygun olduğunu savunarak iddiaları reddetti.

news.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
news.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
news.summaryTr: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
news.articleText: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say - Published European leaders have said they are ready for negotiations with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine, in a strong show of support for Kyiv. "Europe has a clear and consistent and united negotiating position," UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stressed that Moscow's "maximalist demands are not realistic". They were speaking at Berlin's summit of Ukraine's allies known as the Coalition of the Willing. US President Donald Trump's envoys were also there, and his son-in-law Jared Kushner said Trump wanted to make a deal with Russia "with Europe by his side". Russia's Vladimir Putin has so far rejected any European role in the US led peace talks. Trump had earlier held historic trilateral talks in Shenzhen with Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping and later dialled into the Berlin summit from Air Force One. In a lengthy press conference following his talks with Trump and Xi, Putin addressed the question of multilateral peace talks, saying the Americans were "insistently" asking Russia to allow the Europeans to take part. Putin claimed Russia was not against the idea but said Moscow wanted to clarify "what Europe will bring to these talks". "That is why, through diplomatic channels, we have invited the Europeans to come to Moscow in order to determine their positions. And after that, we will decide in what format we will continue the dialogue with Ukraine." But Putin also said that "every day" Russia heard that European leaders were talking about war coming in 2030. "But we are not planning to attack anyone... Is that normal? I do not think so," he said. Still, Putin added, Russia understood that "discussing issues linked to security in Europe is pointless without the Europeans". Jared Kushner told reporters that the US president had come away from Shenzhen believing that "peace is achievable". Striking an upbeat note, Kushner said that the Russians were willing to trust the instinct of the US envoys "on our behalf" that the Europeans should be at the table and that Moscow was now "comfortable" with Ukraine having security guarantees based on the idea enshrined in Nato's Article Five that requires allies to come to a country's defence if it comes under attack. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has long sought a guarantee equivalent to Nato's collective defence clause, and there has been little indication that Putin would accept that kind of condition. Russia has never accepted the idea of Ukrainian membership of Nato, but Article Five-style guarantees could theoretically be offered to Kyiv without being part of the Western defensive alliance. Zelensky and the three European leaders - Merz, Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron - were not as upbeat as Kushner, and the Ukrainian president made clear that the Russian president had spurned every proposal so far: "Putin has always said no." The German chancellor was equally sceptical, although he said with US involvement the chance of peace was increasing. Europe was willing to enter "serious discussions on European security" with Russia, he explained, "as long as it's matched with a serious discussion and only first a peace agreement with Ukraine". "These talks have to begin, and we will accept if conditions are acceptable for Europe and Ukraine," said Merz. There have been mixed messages from Moscow on European participation to the talks. Last week, following a visit to Moscow, Witkoff and Kushner appeared certain that Europe would soon have a seat at the negotiating table. But the Russians were more circumspect and this week Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said a "great deal" would have to be done before the format could be expanded, suggesting that several more rounds of discussions would have to be held before any four-sided talks could take place. Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. While Russia has engaged with several rounds of talks over the last year, little in Moscow's rhetoric or actions suggests that the Kremlin is considering scaling down its war on Ukraine. It continues to pound Kyiv's energy infrastructure to cripple it as winter takes hold, increasing numbers of civilian casualties are being recorded across the country, and Kremlin officials haven't budged from Russia's demands for Ukraine sovereign territory. As delegations were meeting in China and Germany on Thursday, several buildings in Kyiv's historic centre came under attack from drones. One person was killed in a strike on a residential building in the Podilskyi neighbourhood, while the Dutch and Austrian embassies as well as Saint Volodymyr's Cathedral reported damage. And today, Putin vowed that Moscow's response to a Ukrainian strike on the Crimean Bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea would be "considerably more painful" than what Kyiv had achieved. He also said he had discussed a "possible ceasefire in a number of areas" but had decided against it after the attack on the bridge. Still, Putin claimed to be "interested" in ending the war and was ready for making compromises, while Ukraine and Europe were not. "I assure you, we have no desire at all to continue this armed conflict," Putin said.

news.summary: Baykar tarafından geliştirilen KIZILELMA'nın ilk 3 adedi kabul testlerinin tamamlanmasının ardından güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. Türkiye, insansız savaş uçağını envanterine alan dünyadaki ilk ülke oldu.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Türkiye’nin ilk insansız savaş uçağı KIZILELMA envantere girdi: İlk 3 uçak teslim edildi
news.summaryTr: Baykar tarafından geliştirilen KIZILELMA'nın ilk 3 adedi kabul testlerinin tamamlanmasının ardından güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. Türkiye, insansız savaş uçağını envanterine alan dünyadaki ilk ülke oldu.
news.articleText: Türkiye’nin ilk insansız savaş uçağı KIZILELMA envantere girdi: İlk 3 uçak teslim edildi - Baykar tarafından geliştirilen KIZILELMA'nın ilk 3 adedi kabul testlerinin tamamlanmasının ardından güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. Türkiye, insansız savaş uçağını envanterine alan dünyadaki ilk ülke oldu. Türkiye'nin ilk insansız savaş uçağı Bayraktar KIZILELMA, kabul testlerini başarıyla tamamlayarak envantere girdi. Baykar tarafından yapılan açıklamaya göre, ilk 3 KIZILELMA güvenlik güçlerine teslim edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Proje kapsamında bugüne kadar gerçekleştirilen test ve eğitim faaliyetlerinde toplam 600 sorti yapıldı. Teslimatla birlikte KIZILELMA aktif olarak göreve başladı. 2022'de üretim hattına girdi, ilk uçuşunu 2022'de yaptı Kavramsal tasarım görselleri 20 Temmuz 2021'de kamuoyuyla paylaşılan KIZILELMA, 12 Mart 2022'de üretim hattına girdi. İlk uçuşunu ise 14 Aralık 2022'de gerçekleştirdi. 24 Nisan 2023'te AKINCI TİHA ile dünyada ilk kez iki insansız hava aracının yakın kol uçuşunu gerçekleştiren KIZILELMA, aynı yıl TEKNOFEST İstanbul'da insanlı savaş uçakları SOLOTÜRK ve Türk Yıldızları ile kol uçuşu yaptı. Hava-hava muharebesinde tarihi başarı KIZILELMA, 29 Kasım 2025'te Sinop açıklarında gerçekleştirilen testte önemli bir başarıya imza attı. ASELSAN tarafından geliştirilen MURAD AESA radarının işaretlediği jet motorlu hedef uçak, TÜBİTAK SAGE üretimi GÖKDOĞAN görüş ötesi hava-hava füzesiyle vuruldu. Bu testle KIZILELMA, görüş ötesi hava-hava füzesi kullanarak jet motorlu bir hava hedefini vuran dünyadaki ilk insansız savaş uçağı oldu. Süpersonik füze ve dahili mühimmat yuvası testleri Milli insansız savaş uçağı, 13 Temmuz 2026'da JET-230 süpersonik füzesiyle gerçekleştirdiği atış testinde hedefini tam isabetle vurdu. Aynı ay içerisinde düşük görünürlük kabiliyetinin önemli unsurlarından biri olan dahili mühimmat yuvasından TEBER-82 ve TOLUN mühimmatlarıyla ilk atış testleri de başarıyla tamamlandı. Baykar'ın ihracatı 2,2 milyar dolara ulaştı KIZILELMA'nın geliştiricisi Baykar, 2025 yılında 2,2 milyar dolarlık ihracat hacmine ulaştı. Şirket, gelirlerinin yüzde 90'ını ihracattan elde etti. Baykar, Bayraktar TB2 için 37, AKINCI TİHA için 16 ülkeyle ihracat anlaşması imzaladı. Şirketin açıklamasına göre toplam ihracat anlaşması yapılan ülke sayısı 40'a ulaştı. Selçuk Bayraktar: 3 adet KIZILELMA'yı teslim etmenin gururunu yaşıyoruz Baykar Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Selçuk Bayraktar, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada KIZILELMA'nın göreve başladığını duyurdu. Bayraktar, ilk 3 uçağın teslimatına ilişkin şu ifadeleri kullandı: "Dünyada ilk kez bir insansız savaş uçağı envantere giriyor. Vatanımızın her karış toprağını ve göklerimizi korumak üzere 3 adet KIZILELMA'mızı güvenlik güçlerimize teslim etmenin gururunu yaşıyoruz." ASELSAN ve Savunma Sanayii Başkanlığı'ndan açıklama ASELSAN Genel Müdürü Ahmet Akyol, KIZILELMA'nın envantere girmesinin Türkiye havacılık tarihinde yeni bir sayfa açtığını belirterek, projeye ileri teknolojilerle katkı sunmaktan gurur duyduklarını ifade etti. Savunma Sanayii Başkanı Haluk Görgün ise KIZILELMA'nın 20 yıllık bir hayalin gerçeğe dönüşmesi olduğunu vurguladı. Görgün, projede görev alan mühendis ve teknisyenleri tebrik ederek insansız savaş uçağının Türkiye'ye ve Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri'ne hayırlı olmasını diledi.

news.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
news.summary: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
news.summaryTr: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
news.articleText: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies. Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could be pushed back as far as May 2027 if developers decide to modify its specifications to address smart contract compatibility issues, according to discussions at Thursday’s All Core Developers meeting. Glamsterdam is a planned Ethereum hard fork aimed at increasing the network’s capacity and efficiency. However, blockchain security firm ChainSecurity warned in October that proposed changes to Ethereum’s gas pricing could disrupt existing smart contracts and potentially expose them to exploitation, prompting developers to postpone the Hoodi testnet fork, originally scheduled for Oct. 26. The concerns center on gas repricing proposals EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. Researchers identified 13 real-world examples of potentially affected contracts in October, while a November investigation examined eight smart contract invariants that could be disrupted by the upgrade. During Thursday’s meeting, developers said the Ethereum Foundation, ChainSecurity and security firm Dedaub had collectively contacted at least 50 affected companies. Three projects were classified as high impact, with fixes completed or expected by mid-December, while medium-impact projects reported timelines extending to Jan. 10. Developers debated whether to retain Glamsterdam’s existing specifications or modify them to reduce compatibility risks, as changes intended to protect some contracts could disrupt others. “Every spec change could, again, break new invariants that we are not aware of breaking yet,” one developer warned during the meeting. Under the current specifications, mainnet activation could come as early as mid-January 2027. However, waiting until January to decide could push activation to late February or early March, or April or May if modifications are adopted, and no decision has been reached yet. Related: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest Ethereum weighs accelerating post-quantum security Separately, Ethereum’s next planned hard fork, Hegotá, could see its scope reduced as the network seeks to accelerate its transition to post-quantum cryptography. During the meeting, developers considered postponing some Ethereum Improvement Proposals to prioritize post-quantum features, although several argued that reducing the upgrade’s scope would offer little benefit unless it also shortened the rollout timeline. Developers also raised compatibility concerns over EIP-8151, a proposal designed to protect accounts migrating to post-quantum security. A preliminary review identified a potentially large number of existing smart contracts that could be affected by the changes, complicating the proposal’s inclusion in Hegotá. No decision was reached on Hegotá’s scope, with client teams expected to submit their positions ahead of further discussions in two weeks. news.summaryTr: Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, küresel piyasalarda yüksek değerlemeler ve Fed'in faiz politikası nedeniyle sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Karaytuğ, büyük düzeltme beklentisi için 2027'nin Mart-Nisan dönemine işaret etti.
news.articleText: Küresel piyasalarda sert düzeltme riski: Aysun Karaytuğ tarih verdi - Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, küresel piyasalarda yüksek değerlemeler ve Fed'in faiz politikası nedeniyle sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Karaytuğ, büyük düzeltme beklentisi için 2027'nin Mart-Nisan dönemine işaret etti. Gigant Swiss Yatırım Danışma Kurulu Üyesi Aysun Karaytuğ, CNBC-e'de Burcu Göksüzoğlu'nun sunduğu 4'te Ekonomi programında küresel piyasalardaki gelişmeleri değerlendirdi. Yapay zeka şirketlerinin yüksek değerlemeleri, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) faiz politikası ve yatırımcıların değişen tercihleri hakkında konuşan Karaytuğ, önümüzdeki yıl piyasalarda sert bir düzeltme yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) Başkanı Christine Lagarde'ın teknoloji şirketlerindeki yüksek değerlemelere yönelik uyarılarının hatırlatılması üzerine Göksüzoğlu, Karaytuğ'a "Lagarde'ın da bahsettiği gibi sen de böyle bir düzeltme, büyük bir düzeltme bekliyor musun?" sorusunu yöneltti. Karaytuğ, bu soruya "Martta, Mart-Nisan gibi bekliyoruz" yanıtını verdi. Karaytuğ, 2027'nin ilk aylarında ABD'deki siyasi gelişmelerin ve ticaret politikalarının piyasalar açısından belirleyici olacağını söyledi. Ocak ayında ABD'deki siyasi tablonun netleşeceğini, Çin'e yönelik tarifelerin de yeniden gündeme geleceğini belirten Karaytuğ, ticaret politikalarının enflasyon üzerindeki etkilerinin yakından izleneceğini ifade etti. Enerji fiyatlarının yanı sıra iklim koşullarından kaynaklanabilecek gıda fiyatı artışlarının da enflasyonist baskıları güçlendirebileceğini dile getiren Karaytuğ, bu gelişmelerin Fed'in faiz politikasını etkileyebileceğini söyledi. "Değerlemeler zaten çok yüksek" Teknoloji şirketlerindeki değerlemelerin ulaştığı seviyelere dikkat çeken Karaytuğ, faizlerin yeniden cazip hale gelmesinin riskli varlıklardan çıkışı hızlandırabileceğini belirtti. Fed'in faiz artırımlarına devam etmesini beklediklerini ancak 50 baz puanlık tek bir artış yerine 25'er baz puanlık adımların daha olası olduğunu düşündüklerini ifade etti. Karaytuğ, ekim ve kasım aylarında bazı varlıklarda zirve seviyelerinden yüzde 20'ye yaklaşan geri çekilmeler yaşandığını hatırlatarak yüksek değerlemeler ile sıkı para politikasının birleşmesinin piyasalardaki baskıyı artırabileceğini söyledi. Yatırımcıların parası nereye gidiyor? Piyasalardaki satışların ardından sermayenin hangi varlıklara yöneldiğine de değinen Karaytuğ, doların ve faiz getirisi sunan yatırım araçlarının öne çıktığını belirtti. Doların güçlenmesinin özellikle dolar cinsinden fiyatlanan emtialar üzerinde baskı oluşturduğunu ifade eden Karaytuğ, yabancı para birimleriyle yatırım yapanlar açısından bu varlıkların daha pahalı hale geldiğini anlattı. Karaytuğ, yatırımcıların mevcut eğilimi takip etmeyi sürdürebileceğini ve bu sürecin Mart 2027'ye kadar devam edebileceğini öngördü. Altındaki düşüşte yapay zeka etkisine dikkat çekti Altın fiyatlarındaki gerilemeyi de değerlendiren Karaytuğ, satış baskısının yalnızca Fed'in faiz politikası ve güçlü dolardan kaynaklanmadığını söyledi. Anthropic'in halka arzı gibi büyük teknoloji yatırımlarının da yatırımcıların tercihlerini değiştirdiğini belirten Karaytuğ, değerli metallerden yapay zeka ve teknoloji şirketlerine doğru sermaye geçişi yaşandığını ifade etti. Karaytuğ, kısa vadede altın üzerindeki baskının devam edebileceğini ancak bu eğilimin kalıcı olmasını beklemediklerini dile getirdi. Fed'de 50 baz puanlık artış ihtimalini değerlendirdi Fed'in aralık ayındaki faiz kararına ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Karaytuğ, piyasalarda 25 baz puanlık artış olasılığının yüzde 95, 50 baz puanlık artış olasılığının ise yüzde 5 olarak fiyatlandığını söyledi. 50 baz puanlık artışın mevcut koşullarda oldukça agresif bir adım olacağını belirten Karaytuğ, Fed'in tek bir enflasyon veya istihdam verisine dayanarak böyle bir karar vermesini beklemediklerini ifade etti. Karaytuğ'a göre beklenenden güçlü bir faiz artışı yalnızca ABD piyasalarını değil, Avrupa, Japonya ve İngiltere başta olmak üzere küresel ekonomiyi de etkileyebilir. Karaytuğ, tüm bu riskler birlikte değerlendirildiğinde küresel piyasalarda büyük bir düzeltme açısından 2027'nin Mart-Nisan döneminin öne çıktığını vurguladı.

news.summary: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

news.titleTr: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
news.summaryTr: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.
news.articleText: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting - Published US President Donald Trump and his Russian and Chinese counterparts Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping have issued a "joint declaration of peace" following historic trilateral talks. The three leaders met for 90 minutes in China's south-eastern city of Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. While the presidents have previously had one-on-one meetings, these are their first trilateral talks. "Nobody divided up the world at Yalta. It simply codified the realities that had emerged after WW2. "And when it comes to today's conflicts, the realities on the ground will have to be accepted." "I don't think anyone even expected everything to go so well." Meanwhile, China's president described his meeting with Putin and Trump as "positive, constructive, and highly productive", according to the country's state broadcaster CCTV. It added that Xi recalled "the history of fighting side-by-side during WW2", as the three leaders emphasised the importance of "cherishing the hard-won peace". Thursday's trilateral meeting was reportedly the idea of Putin. Some Russian newspapers called it a "diplomatic victory" as after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine many Western leaders were trying to isolate him. The summit also marked the first time since Russia's war in Ukraine began that Putin took part in an international gathering attended by leaders from countries including Canada, Japan and Australia. US lawmakers responded with frustration to Trump's warmth towards America's geopolitical adversaries. "I was encouraged by some of the commitments that came out of the President's meetings in Asia, particularly the recognition that nuclear war must never be fought," Republican Senator John Curtis said in an emailed statement to the BBC. But Curtis also said he was concerned about Trump's approach to the foreign leaders, adding that "Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are not our friends". "We should not treat them as though they share our values or interests," Curtis, who sits on the Senate foreign relations committee, added. "Doing so risks undermining our national security, weakening trust with our allies, and sending the wrong message about where America stands." Jeanne Shaheen, a ranking Democratic member on the same committee, chose harsher words in her comment. "President Trump's 'friend' is a murderous war criminal," she wrote on X. news.articleText: Rohingya genocide: What was said in court and what happens now? Myanmar has been found guilty of committing genocide against its Rohingya minority by the International Court of Justice (ICJ). The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court. The court found on Thursday that "genocidal intent is the only reasonable inference that can be drawn from the evidence" it had seen. The verdict was reached by a majority of nine votes to six among a panel of judges from around the world. The BBC's Anna Holligan is in the Hague and reports on what the ICJ's ruling means. More on this story: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules

Borsa İstanbul günü düşüşle tamamladı BIST 100 endeksi 19 Kasım Perşembe gününü yüzde 0,67 değer kaybıyla 11.400,09 puandan kapattı. Endeksin gerilediği işlem gününde hisse bazlı hareketlilik dikkat çekti. Üç hisse yüzde 10 değer kaybetti Günün en çok kaybettiren hisseleri PASEU, BURCE ve KLSYN oldu. PASEU ve BURCE yüzde 10, KLSYN ise yüzde 9,99 geriledi. Günün en çok düşen 10 hissesi Düşüşte öne çıkan diğer hisseler En çok değer kaybedenler listesinde KNFRT yüzde 9,84'lük ikinci bir fiyat verisiyle de yer alırken CRDFA yüzde 9,69 geriledi. KNFRT için kaynak tabloda iki farklı kapanış ve değişim verisi bulunuyor. Borsada yüzde 10 yükselen hisseler Endeksin düşüşle kapandığı günde PKART, PEKGY, IHYAY ve OYAYO yüzde 10 değer kazanarak günün en çok yükselen hisseleri oldu. En çok kazandıran ilk 10 hisse Yüzde 9,97 ve üzerinde yükselen hisseler EDATA yüzde 9,97, IEYHO yüzde 9,97, HKTM yüzde 9,96, TKNKA yüzde 9,96 ve DSTKF yüzde 9,96 değer kazandı. Yüzde 9,90'ın üzerinde yükselen hisseler SVGYO yüzde 9,94, PRZMA yüzde 9,94, MANAS yüzde 9,94, ISVEA yüzde 9,94, MMCAS yüzde 9,93, CGCAM yüzde 9,93, NUGYO yüzde 9,92, TEHOL yüzde 9,92 ve OZATD yüzde 9,92 yükseldi. Yükseliş listesinin son sıralarında hangi hisseler var? RALYH yüzde 9,88, IHEVA yüzde 9,86, IDGYO yüzde 9,83, IHLGM yüzde 9,77, RODRG yüzde 9,54 ve USAK yüzde 9,52 yükseliş kaydetti. Günün en çok kazandıran 30 hissesi 19 Kasım'da en çok yükselen hisseler listesindeki 30 şirketin tamamı: Borsada günün tablosu 19 Kasım Perşembe günü BIST 100 endeksi yüzde 0,67 düşerken en çok yükselen hisselerde yüzde 10'a, en çok düşen hisselerde ise yüzde 10'a ulaşan fiyat değişimleri görüldü. Böylece endeksin negatif seyrettiği günde hisse bazında ayrışma öne çıktı.

news.summary: At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".

news.titleTr: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons
news.summaryTr: At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".
news.articleText: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons - Published A South Carolina woman who admitted to drowning her two sons 32 years ago has been denied parole for a second time. Susan Smith, 55, was convicted of killing her boys by strapping them into their car seats and rolling her vehicle into a lake in 1994. "I got to my lowest when I let that car go into that lake," Smith said during a hearing on Thursday with the state board that decides whether to release those in prison on parole. The seven-member board later unanimously turned down her request to be freed. The father of the two boys has vowed to continue to oppose her release, and several people spoke against her in the hearing. Smith, whose lawyers had argued she suffered a mental breakdown during the crime, can apply to the South Carolina Board of Probation, Parole and Pardon Services for parole every two years. She told the board that she had changed and matured since killing three-year-old Michael and one-year-old Alex, and that "I am not the same person I was 32 years ago". She also said she was "very, very sorry" and that she would go back and change the circumstances if she could. "They were innocent children," Smith said. "They did not deserve to die." Her children's father, David Smith, attended the hearing so he could advocate for their sons, he said. The 32 years, he said, do not take away what Smith "deliberately" did. "I know in my heart granting her parole would be a huge injustice to Michael and Alex," said David Smith, who had pinned a photo of both his sons to his lapel. Prosecutors argued during the trial that Smith killed the boys after a man with whom she was having an affair told her that her sons were the reason that the pair did not have a future together. At Thursday's hearing, Smith said: "This did not happen because of a man. That's just not true." When the boys first disappeared, Smith said she was carjacked late at night and a man drove away with her car. While she pleaded publicly for their safe return, her sons were at the bottom of a nearby lake. But ultimately she confessed to the crime. Defence lawyers said she had wanted to die with her children but left the car at the last minute. Smith was convicted of murder. Under South Carolina law at the time, she was allowed to request parole every two years after serving 30 years in prison. In the US, some people convicted of crimes are eligible for parole, which means they can be released from incarceration. She would have needed two-thirds of the board members present to vote in her favour to be freed. Related topics - Published20 November 2024
